patch.description: Accept, ready, complete or cancel an order. Only the next valid step is allowed (409 otherwise).

get.description: The Paytm payment in progress (or waiting for the merchant) for this bill, if any.

schema.title: Response Get Current Api V1 Payments Paytm Current Get

post.description:
Start (or continue) paying an open bill through Paytm. The amount is the bill's total,
computed by the backend. The bill is not paid until /verify says so.

Ask Paytm what happened and act on its answer. Takes no status from the caller.
Safe to repeat: a paid bill is completed once.
Give up a payment that Paytm has not received. If Paytm did receive it, the bill is completed instead.

post.description:
Detect products in a photo and match them to this merchant's catalog.
Read-only: the image is not stored and nothing is added to a cart.

One live camera frame -> detections matched to this merchant's catalog.
Read-only, like /recognize: frames are not stored and no cart is touched.

schema.title: Response List Reference Images Api V1 Vision Products  Product Id  Reference Images Get

post.description:
Teach Vision what this product's packaging looks like. The photo itself is not kept:
only its appearance embedding and a small thumbnail.

Read a photo of a parchi and match each line to this merchant's catalogue.
Read-only: the image is not stored and nothing is added to a cart.

Turn a speech-to-text transcript into items matched to this merchant's catalogue.
Read-only: nothing is stored and nothing is added to a cart.

schema.title: Response List Products Api V1 Public Stores  Store Slug  Products Get

post.description:
Place an order with this store. Prices, totals and stock are decided by the backend.
The order is pending and unpaid until the merchant accepts and hands it over.

AssistantTurn.title: AssistantTurn
AssistantTurn.description: One earlier message of this conversation, so a follow-up question keeps its meaning.

BillRead.title: BillRead
BillRead.description: An order plus how it was settled: what the counter shows (and prints) after checkout.

BoundingBoxRead.title: BoundingBoxRead
BoundingBoxRead.description: Normalized to the image size (0..1, origin top-left).

CartItemAdd.title: CartItemAdd
CartItemAdd.description: Identify the product by id or barcode (exactly one).

CheckoutMethod.title: CheckoutMethod
CheckoutMethod.description: PaymentMethod plus KHATA (no money changes hands; a khata credit is recorded).

ConfirmedItemsAdd.title: ConfirmedItemsAdd
ConfirmedItemsAdd.description: Recognized items the merchant confirmed (vision now; voice/parchi later).

CrossSellSuggestion.title: CrossSellSuggestion
CrossSellSuggestion.description: A product frequently bought alongside what's already in the cart, not itself in it.

Detection.title: Detection
Detection.description:
One thing the provider saw, and how it maps onto this merchant's catalog.
Nothing is added to a cart until the merchant confirms.

DetectionEvidence.title: DetectionEvidence
DetectionEvidence.description:
Why the top catalog product was (or was not) chosen: 0..1 support from each signal.
These are evidence scores, not calibrated probabilities.

InputSource.title: InputSource
InputSource.description:
How a line item / ledger entry entered the system. Every billing input
(manual, barcode, vision, voice, parchi, assistant) converges on the same services.

InsightActionStatus.title: InsightActionStatus
InsightActionStatus.description:
What a staff member did about a computed insight (app.modules.insights). The insight
itself is never stored, only this, keyed by its stable insight_key.

MerchantUpdate.title: MerchantUpdate
MerchantUpdate.description: Set or clear the store's GSTIN (null clears it). Shown on bills once set; not required to sell.

OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus
OrderStatus.description:
A Counter bill is completed at checkout. A Shop order is placed pending and the merchant
moves it: pending -> confirmed -> ready -> completed, or cancels it before completion
(orders.service.TRANSITIONS).

OrderStatusUpdate.title: OrderStatusUpdate
OrderStatusUpdate.description: Move an order along its lifecycle. Which moves are allowed is decided by the backend.

ParchiLine.title: ParchiLine
ParchiLine.description:
One written line and how it maps onto this merchant's catalogue.
Nothing is added to a cart until the merchant confirms.

PaytmCheckout.title: PaytmCheckout
PaytmCheckout.description: What Paytm's JS Checkout needs in the browser. The merchant key is never part of this.

PaytmConfigRead.title: PaytmConfigRead
PaytmConfigRead.description: Whether "Pay with Paytm" can be offered. No credentials.

PaytmPaymentRead.title: PaytmPaymentRead
PaytmPaymentRead.description: One Paytm attempt for a bill, as verified by the backend.

PaytmPaymentStatus.title: PaytmPaymentStatus
PaytmPaymentStatus.description: One Paytm attempt for a bill. Only Paytm's own answer, fetched by the backend, moves it.

PaytmStart.title: PaytmStart
PaytmStart.description: The bill to collect. There is no amount: the backend computes it from the cart.

ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate
ProductUpdate.description: Partial update. Stock is intentionally absent: use /inventory/adjustments.

ReferenceImageRead.title: ReferenceImageRead
ReferenceImageRead.description: A merchant's photo of a product's real packaging (only a thumbnail is kept).

StoreOrderCreate.title: StoreOrderCreate
StoreOrderCreate.description: What the customer wants. There are no prices and no totals: the backend computes them.

StoreOrderRead.title: StoreOrderRead
StoreOrderRead.description: The customer's view of their order.

VoiceLine.title: VoiceLine
VoiceLine.description:
One spoken item and how it maps onto this merchant's catalogue.
Nothing is added to a cart until the merchant confirms.
